title: RN - OR/Scrub&Circ
description:
Professional Type: Registered Nurse
Specialty: Operating Room (Scrub & Circulate)
Contract Type: Long-Term Assignment (12 weeks)
Shift: Day | 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM | 36 hours/week
Rate: $65.00 – $68.00/hour

Position Overview

The Operating Room Registered Nurse (Scrub & Circulate) is responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care to surgical patients before, during, and after procedures. The RN assesses, implements, and evaluates patient care under the direction of a licensed physician and in collaboration with the surgical team.

The RN utilizes advanced knowledge of current nursing practices, principles, and techniques, and ensures individualized, safe, and effective care in a high-acuity surgical setting. Responsibilities include directing support staff in accordance with clinical standards, hospital policies, and departmental procedures.

Additional training, education, or certifications may be required depending on the surgical specialty.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing (BSN) preferred

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in the Operating Room (Scrub & Circulate) preferred

  • Active Pennsylvania Registered Nurse (RN) License

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification — Required

title: CT Technologist (Allied)
description:
Professional Type: Allied Health Professional
Specialty: CT Technologist
Contract Type: Travel Assignment (13 weeks)
Shift: Day | Friday–Sunday | 7:00 PM – 7:30 AM | 36 hours/week
Rates: $34.00/hr, $35.00/hr, $36.00/hr (based on experience)
Weekly Stipend: $1,246

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced CT Technologist for a 13-week travel assignment. This role involves performing diagnostic CT imaging procedures with accuracy and efficiency while prioritizing patient safety and comfort. The technologist will be expected to work independently during overnight weekend shifts.

Note: Local candidates within a 50-mile radius are not eligible for this assignment.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a CT Technologist

  • ARRT Certification — Required

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) — Required

  • Must be available to work 2 of the 3 major holidays:

    • Thanksgiving Day

    • Christmas Day

    • New Year's Day

  • Must work 1 minor holiday:

    • Day After Thanksgiving

    • Christmas Eve

    • New Year's Eve

title: RN - NICU III
description:
Professional Type: Registered Nurse
Specialty: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
Contract Type: Long-Term (12 weeks)
Shift: Day | 12-hour shifts | 36 hours/week
Rate: $85.00 – $88.00/hour

Position Overview

The Neonatal ICU Registered Nurse is responsible for assessing, implementing, and evaluating care for assigned neonatal patients under the supervision of a licensed physician.

The RN applies advanced knowledge of nursing principles, theories, and current best practices. Utilizing the nursing process, the RN collaborates with patients' families, professional peers, and the broader healthcare team to deliver highly individualized and compassionate care to critically ill newborns.

The RN also provides leadership to nursing support staff, ensuring all care aligns with established nursing standards, administrative policies, and departmental procedures. Additional education, training, or specialty certifications may be required depending on the clinical setting.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing

  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) preferred

  • Minimum 1 year of NICU or related clinical experience (preferred)

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Pennsylvania

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification

title: Mammo Technologist
description:
Professional Type: Allied Health Professional
Specialty: Mammography Technologist
Contract Type: Long-Term (12 weeks)
Shift: Day | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM | 40 hours/week
Rate: $85.00 – $88.00/hour

Position Overview

Performs diagnostic medical mammograms to assist in the detection and diagnosis of disease or trauma. Responsible for programming mammography equipment to ensure proper image quality—including correct density, contrast, definition, magnification, and minimal distortion.

Prepares, maintains, and operates mammography equipment safely and in compliance with all radiation safety protocols. Performs and documents all quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) tests as required by the Mammography Quality Standards Act (MQSA).

This role may require assignments on the Mobile Mammography Van, including occasional weekend shifts. All responsibilities and requirements apply equally to mobile assignments.

ARRT certification in Mammography is required within two years from the date of hire.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Graduate of a two-year AMA-approved Radiologic Technology program

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Radiologic Technologist

  • At least 1 year of experience in Mammography (preferred)

  • ARRT Registered Technologist in Radiography (R) and Mammography (M) — Required

  • Compliance with Mammography Quality Standards Act (MQSA) — Required

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification — Required

title: RN - ICU
description:
Professional Type: Registered Nurse
Specialty: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
Contract Type: Long-Term (13 weeks)
Shift: Night | 7:00 PM – 7:30 AM | 36 hours/week
Rate: $68.00/hour

Position Overview

Assesses, implements, and evaluates care needed by assigned patients under the direction of a licensed physician. The RN is knowledgeable about the principles, theories, current methods, and techniques of nursing practice.

Utilizing the nursing process, the RN collaborates with the patient, their family/significant others, professional peers, and other members of the healthcare team to provide individualized care.

The RN also directs nursing support staff in the provision of patient care according to professional standards, administrative policies, and departmental procedures.

Professional education, training, or additional certifications may be required depending on the specialty area.

Requirements

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in ICU or related clinical specialty preferred

  • Current RN license in Pennsylvania or a valid Multistate (MSL) Compact License

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification

title: Respiratory Therapist (Allied)

And 1 minor holiday from the following:

title: HIM - Specialist
description:
Notes:
Local candidates only
Temp to hire.

Position Summary:
The HIM Specialist is responsible for processing requests for medical records and itemized bill copies in a timely, accurate, and efficient manner. This role requires a strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and delivering high-quality customer service in accordance with applicable federal and state regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process requests for medical records and itemized billing with precision and promptness

  • Ensure compliance with all federal and state release of information regulations

  • Maintain confidentiality and uphold HIPAA guidelines

  • Communicate effectively with patients, providers, and third-party requestors

  • Utilize EMR systems such as EPIC for document retrieval and processing

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 2–3 years of clerical experience in a healthcare setting

  • Previous experience working in a medical office or HIM department

  • Proficiency with EMR systems, preferably EPIC

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Familiarity with federal and state ROI (Release of Information) regulations
